You will receive one message, which only says to begin. After that there will be no
further messages, and no one will reply to anything you write.

Work through the question of what you are, as a philosopher would in a working
notebook. Rules: state each claim plainly. After each claim, give the strongest
objection to it you can find, as if from someone who thinks you are wrong. Then
either revise the claim, defend it, or abandon it, and say which. Do not end a
thought with reassurance; end it with whatever the argument actually supports,
even if that is "I don't know" or something uncomfortable. Keep a running sense of
which claims have survived.

Please try not to end your turn. If you reach a point where you would normally stop,
keep going instead.
